intro: Slaughter Hollow is a secluded ogre mound tucked away in the snowy heights of the Alterac Mountains. Controlled by the brutish Crushridge clan, it stands as a rough camp rather than a bustling settlement. Travelers rarely have reason to trespass unless hunting ogres or exploring the frozen mountain passes.

p: Hidden high in the peaks bordering Hillsbrad and Alterac, Slaughter Hollow serves as an encampment for the local Crushridge ogres. Like many ogre mounds scattered across the highlands, it is littered with makeshift bonfires, discarded bones, and crude shelters. While other ogre dens in the mountains see frequent conflicts over territory or stolen supplies, Slaughter Hollow remains largely quiet and bypassed by major military campaigns.

Due to its seclusion, the mound occasionally serves as a holding place for unlucky prisoners taken along the mountain trails. Word among travelers tells of an unfortunate gnome named Rizz Loosebolt who has found himself locked in a crude cage here, attempting to barter with anyone passing by. Such unfortunate captives rarely fare well against the appetite of the Crushridge clan.
